//: Bulwark — production app manifest. The static demo at demo/ is not a Nuxt app and has no package.json. This file governs the real product (ADR-0001, ADR-0011).
name: bulwark

scripts.//1: Dev server runs Nuxt against the real backend by default (ADR-0015). Requires a local Postgres + DATABASE_URL in .env.local. Set BULWARK_BACKEND=mock for offline dev demos.
scripts.//2: Generate static demo only — not the production build path.
scripts.//3: Playwright spec for every UI-affecting story (ADR-0007). Defaults to BULWARK_BACKEND=real (ADR-0015); to run the mock lane, set BULWARK_BACKEND=mock in the environment before invoking.
scripts.//4: Drizzle is wired in E0-S4 (schemas) and applied in E11-S1 (migrations).
scripts.//4a: db:reset wipes + remigrates + reseeds. DEV ONLY (ADR-0015). The drop step is gated by DATABASE_URL containing localhost/127.0.0.1; set BULWARK_ALLOW_PROD_SEED=1 to override (don't).
scripts.//5: Background worker (E11-S9 / ADR-0012). Render Start Command: pnpm run worker:jobs.
scripts.//6: CodeGraph (agents/codegraph/). Rebuild after adding/moving pages, components, services, tests or design specs; query instead of grepping. See agents/codegraph/INDEX.md.
scripts.//7: Screen-contract tests (tests/e2e/screens). scaffold = generate a fixme-skeleton from a design SPEC; baseline = render design HTML to PNG baselines; audit = gate for moving a screen WP to review.

//9: pnpm.overrides pin patched same-major versions of vulnerable transitive deps (WP-L07 S5; see scripts/security/audit-gate.mjs). Remove an entry once the direct dependency ships the fix.
